name: Walmart OnePay CashRewards

apr.notes: 20.24% for Account Type 1 or 30.74% for Account Type 2 when you open your account, based on your creditworthiness and other factors. After that, your APR will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. APR will not exceed 35.99%. Cash advance APR: 22.24% for Account Type 1 or 32.24% for Account Type 2. Minimum interest charge $2.00. Late payment fee up to $41. Returned payment fee up to $41. Cash advance fee: either $10 or 5% of the amount, whichever is greater. Information accurate as of January 1, 2026.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee. Non-USD transactions converted to U.S. dollars using exchange rates from the transaction or processing date.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated on official pages. APR is based on creditworthiness and other factors. If not approved for CashRewards, may be considered for OnePay Walmart Spend Card (store-only). Prior 'fair' rating was based on third-party (WalletHub) — not verified from official source.

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on all other purchases anywhere Mastercard is accepted

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is earned as points on purchases made with your OnePay CashRewards Mastercard, which can be redeemed as a statement credit, as a deposit into a OnePay deposit account, or other available options. Must have at least 25 points to make a redemption. OnePay Points redeemed for a statement credit or electronic deposit redeem at a value of $0.01 per OnePay Point. Walmart+ membership required for 5% rate.

signup_bonus.description: Get $35 cash back upon account opening. Awarded as points, which you can redeem into a OnePay deposit account or as a statement credit. Offer valid for new accounts only; each account is only eligible for one Welcome Bonus.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: No annual fee for the OnePay CashRewards Card.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fee
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fee is charged. Non-USD transactions are converted to U.S. dollars using exchange rates from the transaction or processing date.

benefits.title: Spending Insights
benefits.description: Get insights about your everyday credit card spending habits.

benefits.title: Card Lock
benefits.description: Lock your credit card if it's lost or stolen in just a few taps.

benefits.title: Free Credit Score
benefits.description: OnePay Credit Score provides real-time updates and deeper insights into your credit, for free.

benefits.title: World Mastercard Perks and Benefits
benefits.description: World Mastercard offers even more perks and benefits powered by the global Mastercard Network.

notes: Issued by Synchrony Bank. World Mastercard.
